title: Great pillow inserts!
text: Great pillow inserts!. This is a great, convenient, 4 pack of pillow inserts. I had bought some decorative sea life pillow covers that had been sitting in my linen closet for months now waiting for me to make my way to Michaels to buy inserts. I was thrilled to see that Amazon sells these, and a 4 pack is just what I needed. These are the right size (18"), well made, sturdy and fit inside my cases perfectly.  These are great for my living room set. Perfect!

product_metadata.title: Amazon Basics Pillow Insert - 18-Inch Square, 4-Pack
features: Made with an ultra soft, polyester down-alternative filler; 4 pillows included
Great for replacing old inserts or filling new decorative throw pillow covers
Hypoallergenic and vacuum-sealed in a white polyester shell for durability
Measurements are seam to seam. It is recommended to order one size up from your cover's stated size.
